name: Tannok Frosthammer
summary: At Thunderbrew Distillery outside Kharanos, Tannok Frosthammer waits anxiously for supplies from Coldridge Valley. Trogg attacks have cut off the roads to Anvilmar.

sections.title: A Severed Supply Line
sections.body: Tannok Frosthammer watches deliveries and listens for news at Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. Troggs have surged through Coldridge Pass, cutting off the usual route from Coldridge Valley and regular word from Anvilmar. Hands Springsprocket, a gnome tinkerer, carries supplies and news through the dangerous, snowy pass. Tannok shares the quiet worry of many Bronzebeards as subterranean troggs creep closer to their doorsteps.

faq.answer: Tannok Frosthammer is outside Thunderbrew Distillery, just east of Kharanos's main crossroads in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Why is Tannok worried about Coldridge Valley?
faq.answer: Troggs have overrun Coldridge Pass, cutting off regular communication and trade between Anvilmar and the rest of Dun Morogh.

faq.q: Who does Tannok work with in Coldridge Valley?
faq.answer: Tannok receives deliveries from Hands Springsprocket, a gnomish supplier in Coldridge Valley who asks passing travelers to carry goods through the dangerous pass.

angles.text: As a dwarf leaving Anvilmar, carrying supplies to Tannok at Thunderbrew Distillery is one of your first steps into the heart of Dun Morogh.
As an Alliance member, you can see how rising trogg attacks strain even heartland settlements like Kharanos.
